_meta.engine_compatibility: filter_engine.py v14.1 / config.py v13.1 / database.py v9.0 / monitors.py v9.7 / main.py v13.1
_meta.architecture: NLP Pipeline — Tokenization → Entity Extraction → Negation Analysis → Dependency Analysis → Distance Scoring → Ad Detection → Confidence Engine → Explainability
design_principles: Template-driven generation AND a curated static high_confidence_boost_patterns list co-exist: templates cover combinatorial coverage, the static list covers precise, high-value phrases that are not natural template combinations
Every lexicon entry has ONE canonical form
Ad detection: strong_provider = immediate reject, weak_provider requires 3+ commercial signals
Negation is clause-based with explicit boundaries
Token distance modifies score; message length modifies confidence
English academic terms receive lower weight unless accompanied by Arabic intent verb
Auto-learning disabled; human approval required for feedback integration

CRITICAL: every keyword string used for trie matching MUST already be in normalized form (no أ/إ/آ/ة/ى/ئ/ؤ). filter_engine.py normalizes INPUT text via _normalize_arabic() before searching the tries, but keyword entries loaded from this file are used AS-IS, with no normalization applied on the keywords side. An entry containing 'ة' or 'أ' etc. will never match normalized input and is silently dead weight — this is the same failure class as the original templates/config.py bug, just at the data layer instead of the loader layer.

test_cases.*.text are deliberately left in natural/raw Arabic spelling (with ة, hamzas, etc.) because they represent simulated RAW user input that itself passes through the normalization pipeline during a test run — normalizing them here would test something other than production behavior.

confidence_thresholds_design_target._note: These are the DESIGN target thresholds this keyword set was tuned against. The ACTUAL runtime thresholds come from CFG.CONFIDENCE_ACCEPT_THRESHOLD / CFG.CONFIDENCE_REVIEW_THRESHOLD in config.py (env-overridable), whose current defaults are 0.65 / 0.40, not 0.78 / 0.55. Set CONFIDENCE_ACCEPT_THRESHOLD=0.78 and CONFIDENCE_REVIEW_THRESHOLD=0.55 in accounts.env to match this file's tuning, or re-tune this file's boost/weight values against the 0.65/0.40 defaults. This mismatch is exactly the kind of 'JSON documents one thing, runtime does another' gap the engineering audit warned about (see fixes_changelog, item 9).

fixes_changelog: 1) [confirmed already fixed upstream] templates/template_patterns reach KEYWORDS: config.py v13.1's _KW_CATEGORIES now includes 'templates' and 'template_patterns' — verified this file's data is structurally compatible with that loader (dict-of-lists under 'templates', list-of-strings under 'template_patterns').

2) [confirmed already fixed upstream] filter_engine.py v14.1's _generate_template_patterns() receives real data end-to-end (config.py -> KEYWORDS -> EnhancedFilter._load_keyword_sets -> WeightedTrie).

3) [new bug found + fixed] template_patterns previously listed 12 combinations, but filter_engine.py v14.1's _generate_template_patterns() only implements 7 exact tag combinations (2-part: <need><person>, <need><expert>, <availability><person>, <availability><action>, <availability><expert>; 3-part: <need><person><action>, <availability><person><action>). The other 5 patterns (anything referencing <academic_object> or <urgency>, and any 4-part pattern) were silently ignored by the generator — same failure class as the original P0 bug, just reintroduced at the content layer. template_patterns has been trimmed to exactly the 7 supported combinations. Do not add <academic_object>/<urgency> combinations or patterns with more than 3 tags back into template_patterns unless filter_engine.py's _generate_template_patterns() is extended to parse them first.

4) [new bug found + fixed] length_modifier keys used the format '1_3_tokens' etc., but filter_engine.py's parser only recognizes the '_to_' delimiter ('X_to_Y'). Every length_modifier entry was silently dropped at load time (get_length_modifier() always fell back to the 0.9 default). Keys renamed to '1_to_3', '4_to_10', '11_to_30', '31_to_9999'.

5) [new bug found + fixed] filter_engine.py's _detect_advertisement() reads a TOP-LEVEL 'ad_blockers' array (self._ad_blockers = set(kw.get('ad_blockers', []))), used both for the early ad_blocker_trie short-circuit in analyze() and for a +0.2 ad-score contribution. This top-level key did not exist in v15 (only the never-loaded 'url_and_contact_signals' section existed, which is not in config.py's _KW_CATEGORIES and was therefore silently dropped at load — see item 7). The ad_blocker mechanism was effectively disabled. Added a real top-level 'ad_blockers' array; removed the dead 'url_and_contact_signals' section.

6) [new bug found + fixed, file-wide] Arabic hamza/ta-marbuta normalization mismatch: many keyword entries used unnormalized forms (أ/إ/آ/ة/ى/ئ/ؤ) which can never match normalized runtime input (see design_principles note above). Performed a normalization pass across every matchable field (templates, intent_verbs, request_phrases, academic_objects, advertisement_signals, ignore_signals, spam_categories, university_context, dialect_mapping, subject_markers, negation, etc.). Removed a handful of entries that were exact duplicates of an already-correct normalized sibling entry (e.g. 'رسالة ماجستير' duplicating 'رساله ماجستير'). test_cases.*.text intentionally left un-normalized (see design_principles).

7) [decision documented] high_confidence_boost_patterns: the original engineering report flagged this as an undecided design question (static list vs template engine). Decision made explicit here: BOTH are used. high_confidence_boost_patterns.patterns now holds curated, high-precision multi-word phrases (including everything merged in from the external keyword list) that are not expressible as template combinations; template_patterns continues to generate the large combinatorial set. filter_engine.py already unions both into self._boost_patterns, so no code change was required.

8) [documented, not silently dropped] Legacy/pre-v13 flat keys still listed in config.py's _KW_CATEGORIES ('request', 'advertisement', 'ignore', 'emoji_advertisement', 'education_providers', 'request_context', 'indirect_request', 'urgency', 'spam_patterns') are intentionally present as empty arrays rather than simply absent. Their functionality is fully superseded by the v13+/v15 structured sections (intent_verbs+request_phrases, advertisement_signals, ignore_signals, emoji_signals.ad_style_emoji, advertisement_signals.institution_terms, request_phrases, implicit_request_patterns, urgency_markers, spam_categories respectively). Keeping them present-but-empty, with this note, makes the schema contract discoverable instead of silently absent — directly resolving the audit's Problem #4/#8/#9 (schema mismatch / gaps that should be visible, not silent).

9) academic_object_weight and url_and_contact_signals sections were removed from the top level: neither key is in config.py's _KW_CATEGORIES, so both were being silently dropped by load_keywords() before ever reaching filter_engine.py — dead JSON that looked functional but never executed. url_and_contact_signals' actual data is now live under the top-level 'ad_blockers' key (see item 5). academic_object_weight (exact_phrase_multiplier / single_word_multiplier) is not implemented anywhere in filter_engine.py v14.1's scoring path; noted here as a documented future-feature idea rather than left as misleading dead configuration.

10) Merged the externally-provided general/subject-specific keyword list into the file: general request phrasings were added to request_phrases.direct_requests; 'عندي <thing>' statements were added to implicit_request_patterns.problem_state; subject-specific combined phrases (بحث/تقرير/واجب/مشروع/عرض/إكسل/خريطة مفاهيم/اختبار) were added to high_confidence_boost_patterns.patterns for maximum precision as exact phrase matches. All merged in normalized form, de-duplicated against existing entries (e.g. 'عندي واجب' / 'عندي مشروع' / 'عندي بحث' already existed and were not re-added).

11) explainability.example.reasons updated to match the ACTUAL reason-string formats produced by filter_engine.py's analyze() (e.g. 'intent_verb: X', 'academic_object: X', 'template_boost: X') instead of an illustrative-but-inaccurate example.

12) Nothing was deleted from request/advertisement/ignore/action_verbs/subject_markers/implicit_request_patterns/solve_actions/help_expressions content itself (per the audit's explicit 'do not touch' list) beyond the character-level normalization fixes and duplicate removal described above.

templates._description: Word sets for template-based pattern generation. Engine combines them according to template_patterns at load time. Only 'need','person','action','expert','availability' are read by filter_engine.py v14.1's _generate_template_patterns(); 'urgency' is kept as a reserved/documented word bank for a future engine version that adds <urgency> tag support (see fixes_changelog item 3) — it is NOT currently consumed by the generator.

intent_verbs._description: Canonical first-person verb stems. Weighted for high precision.

implicit_request_patterns._note: Score only if academic object/context present

solve_actions._note: If 'حل' appears with technical_problem_terms, academic score for that object is halved

academic_objects._description: Specific academic items; enriched with high-precision terms.

subject_markers._description: Comprehensive set of markers that identify the speaker as a student seeking help.
subject_markers._note: Possessive suffixes (ي, نا) attached to academic objects are also detected via normalization.

provider_profile._rule: strong_provider/individual_provider + any commercial signal = immediate reject. weak_provider requires 3+ commercial signals.

_ad_blockers_note: Read directly by filter_engine.py (self._ad_blockers = set(kw.get('ad_blockers', []))) — used both for the early ad_blocker_trie short-circuit in analyze() and as a +0.2 ad-score contribution in _detect_advertisement(). This key did not exist as a top-level array in the previous version (only the never-loaded 'url_and_contact_signals' section existed), so the ad-blocker mechanism was silently inert — see fixes_changelog item 5.

length_modifier._note: FIXED (fixes_changelog item 4): keys renamed from '1_3_tokens' style to the 'X_to_Y' format filter_engine.py's _load_keyword_sets() actually parses (it splits on '_to_'). The old key format matched isinstance(key,str) and 'in key' checks that always evaluated false, so every entry was silently dropped and get_length_modifier() always fell back to its 0.9 default regardless of message length.

scoring_weights._note: Documentation of the DESIGN target weights. filter_engine.py v14.1 actually blends confidence using CFG.SCORE_WEIGHT_INTENT/ACADEMIC/GRAMMAR/DISTANCE/URGENCY/CONTEXT from config.py (env-overridable). Keep these two in sync manually when re-tuning: current config.py defaults are intent=0.30, academic=0.25, grammar=0.15, distance=0.15, urgency=0.05, context=0.10.

negation_score.effect: multiplies base confidence by (1 - negation_score * 0.7), matching filter_engine.py's analyze()

advert_score.effect: multiplies base confidence by (1 - advert_score * 0.9), matching filter_engine.py's analyze()

explainability._note: reasons strings match the exact formats filter_engine.py's analyze() actually appends: 'intent_verb: X', 'academic_object: X', 'urgency: X', 'implicit_request', negation reasons, ad_detection reasons, 'template_boost: X'.

test_cases._note: text values are intentionally natural/raw Arabic (ة, hamzas, etc. as a real user would type) — they are run through the SAME normalization pipeline as production input, so pre-normalizing them here would test something other than real behavior. See _meta.design_principles.

high_confidence_boost_patterns._note: Curated static high-precision phrases, complementary to (not a replacement for) template_patterns' combinatorial generation — see fixes_changelog item 7. filter_engine.py's _load_keyword_sets() reads boost_data.get('patterns', []) from this section and unions it with the template-generated set into self._boost_patterns; a match adds +0.25 confidence and 'template_boost: X' to reasons. Includes the subject-specific phrasing merged in from the external keyword list (bahth/taqrir/wajib/mashroo'/'ard/Excel/khareeta mafaheem/ikhtibar).

_legacy_keys_note: The 9 keys directly above (request, advertisement, ignore, emoji_advertisement, education_providers, request_context, indirect_request, urgency, spam_patterns) are pre-v13 flat-list keys still present in config.py's _KW_CATEGORIES for backward compatibility. They are intentionally kept as EMPTY arrays rather than removed or left absent, so the schema contract stays fully visible (see fixes_changelog item 8) instead of silently missing. Their function is fully covered by the structured v13+/v15 sections above (intent_verbs+request_phrases, advertisement_signals, ignore_signals, emoji_signals.ad_style_emoji, advertisement_signals.institution_terms, request_phrases/implicit_request_patterns, urgency_markers, spam_categories, respectively). Do not populate these unless a genuine need for the flat legacy format is identified — populating them would create a second, harder-to-maintain source of truth for data that already exists in the structured sections.
